title: Impl: DAO storm window in Rust ForwardBuffer
description: Add storm_deadline_ms: u64 to ForwardBuffer. On parent change, set to now_ms+5000. In try_buffer(), if now_ms < storm_deadline_ms, per_source_limit=4. File: rust/lichen-node/src/forward_buffer.rs. Verify: cd rust && cargo test -p lichen-node
